extDescription.message: Color-code Planning Tasks and Milestones on the Jira Cloud Timeline, mark weekends and public holidays, and show working days.

optionsTitle.message: Time color for Jira: Manage settings

ptTargetEndShadeLabel.message: Shade from Target end to Due date

msDiamondLabel.message: Show as a diamond at the due date

msShowProgressLabel.message: Show linked issue progress and due date (e.g. 3/11 27% · DUE 8/30)

epicStripeLabel.message: Show a dashed outline for Epics flagged by your admin

hideCurrentMonthLabel.message: Hide the current period highlight (today's blue line stays)

hideIssueKeyLabel.message: Hide issue keys in the left column (e.g. ABC-1234)

showWorkingDaysLabel.message: Show working days when you hover over or drag a bar (weekends and holidays excluded)

hideCurrentMonthInfoBody.message: Jira adds a translucent highlight to the current month, week, or quarter column. Turning this on removes it; today's blue line still shows.

popupHintApply.message: Changes apply right away to open Jira tabs.

popupHintToolbar.message: To pause or refresh, use the floating toolbar at the bottom right of the Jira page.

statusProjectReady.message: Using the settings saved in this Jira project

popupImportPrompt.message: Import the configuration file from your admin in Manage settings.

popupDefaultMessage.message: Site settings can be imported in Manage settings.

vDuplicateTypes.message: The same issue type can't be used for more than one role.

vHighlightValue.message: The match value must be plain text of up to 100 characters.

vBoolean.message: A true or false value is required.

vWeekendDays.message: Days of the week must be unique numbers from 0 to 6.

vPreferences.message: Preferences contain unknown or invalid values.

vStartDateRequired.message: Date features that are turned on need a start date field.

vTargetEndRequired.message: Target end shading needs a Target end field.

vLinkTypesRequired.message: Milestone progress needs at least one link type ID.

vEpicFlagRequired.message: The Epic outline needs a flag field.

vSiteOrigin.message: Sites must be standard HTTPS atlassian.net addresses.

errCorrupt.message: Saved settings couldn't be verified. Import a valid configuration again.

errDisconnected.message: Can't reach the extension. Reopen the panel or reload the Jira tab.

errNoResponse.message: The settings service didn't respond. Reopen the panel.

sessionNeedsConfig.message: Import the configuration file from your admin

sessionTypesUnavailable.message: Some issue types can't be used. Ask your admin to check the configuration

sessionFieldUnavailable.message: The {field} field isn't available. Ask your admin to check

statusCantCheck.message: Can't check Jira right now. Please try again later

tbNotConfigured.message: Not set up. Open Manage settings from the extension panel.

tbMoveTitle.message: Move toolbar: arrow keys move it, Home or End jumps to an edge, Enter switches between top and right

optionsLead.message: Import the configuration file from your admin, review it, then save. Colors and display options can be changed in the extension panel.

chooseConfigLabel.message: Choose the JSON configuration file from your admin

dropHint.message: You can also drop the file here. You'll see a preview before anything is saved.

previewHint.message: Everything below will be saved. If it overlaps an existing configuration, you'll be asked before saving.

refreshJira.message: Reload data in open Jira tabs

toolsHint.message: Restoring a configuration keeps the colors and switches you changed. Resetting appearance only clears your own changes; admin settings aren't affected. Reloading data doesn't refresh the page.

privacySignIn.message: The extension uses your current Jira sign-in. No password or API token is needed.

privacyData.message: Jira issue content is only used in this browser and is never sent to the developer. Site settings and color preferences sync to your other computers through Chrome; unsaved import drafts stay on this computer. Exported files contain admin settings only.

privacyHolidays.message: Holidays are listed in your admin’s configuration file or Jira project settings. The extension only connects to your Jira site, never to other sites.

privacyGenerator.message: What you enter in Create configuration stays on that page, is cleared when you close it, and is never uploaded.

generatorLead.message: For Jira admins: enter issue type and field IDs, then download a configuration file for your users to import. What you enter stays on this page and is cleared when you reload or close it.

errInvalidConfigFile.message: The configuration is incomplete or in the wrong format. Ask your admin for an updated file.

errNothingToRestore.message: There's no previous configuration to restore.

errActionIncomplete.message: The action didn't finish. Please try again later.

noSavedConfig.message: No configuration saved yet. Choose a file above to get started.

configChanged.message: The configuration changed. Import the file again.

noTimelineUrl.message: This configuration has no Timeline link. Open the project Timeline from Jira.

openTimelineFromJira.message: Open the project Timeline from Jira.

reviewBeforeSave.message: Check the site, project, and features, then save.

confirmReplace.message: A configuration already exists for the same site or project. Replace it with this file? Your personal preferences are kept, and you can restore the previous configuration.

replaceCancelled.message: Replacement cancelled. The import preview is kept.

configNotSaved.message: The configuration wasn't saved. Ask your admin for a compatible file.

configSaved.message: Configuration saved. It applies automatically when you open the Jira Timeline.

confirmResetAppearance.message: Reset your appearance preferences? Admin settings are kept.

tabsRefreshedSome.message: Jira tabs updated: {count}. Reload the other tabs manually.

noTabsToRefresh.message: No Jira tabs to update. Open a Jira Timeline and try again.

genIntro.message: Enter Jira issue type and field IDs, then download a configuration file for your users to import.

genNote.message: What you enter stays only on this page and is cleared when you reload or close it. Remember to download.

genEditLabel.message: Choose a JSON file you downloaded before to fill in the form

genSiteUrlHelp.message: For example https://your-site.atlassian.net, with nothing after it.

genRevisionHelp.message: Increase it by 1 each time you update the file so versions are easy to tell apart.

genProjectIdHelp.message: Leave empty to apply to the whole site. Use the numeric ID, not a project key like DEMO.

genTimelinePathHelp.message: Copy the part of the Timeline URL after the domain. If empty, users open the Timeline from Jira themselves.

genProjectIdHowSummary.message: Where do I find the project ID?

genProjectIdHowBody.message: You can find the numeric ID in Jira's project settings or admin pages. Without a project ID, this configuration applies to every project on the site that has no configuration of its own. If projects use different fields, create separate configuration files.

genTypesIntro.message: Enter one numeric ID per type. Different types can't share an ID. Leave unused types empty.

genPlanningHelp.message: Applies the Planning Task color and shows its role on hover.

genMilestoneHelp.message: Can show as a diamond and calculate linked issue progress.

genEpicHelp.message: Lets the extension recognize Epics, e.g. to show working days on hover.

genTypesHowSummary.message: Where do I find issue type and link type IDs?

genTypesHowBody1.message: After you enter the site URL, lookup links appear at the bottom of the page. Open one, find the name in Jira's response, and copy the id next to it. For example, if Planning Task has id 501, enter 501. If names repeat, check which one to use in Jira's admin pages.

genTypesHowBody2.message: If a link won't open, your account probably lacks permission. Look the ID up in Jira's admin pages instead.

genFieldsIntro.message: Enter just the number or the full customfield_<number>. Features whose field is empty stay off.

genRoleHelp.message: Multi-select field used to show roles.

genStartDateHelp.message: Date field. Required for working days, Milestone progress, or Target end shading.

genTargetEndHelp.message: Date field. Required when “Target end shading” is on.

genFieldsHowSummary.message: Where do I find field IDs?

genFieldsHowBody1.message: Open the “Custom field IDs” link at the bottom of the page, find the field name, and copy its id. For example, if the role field has id customfield_502, enter 502 or customfield_502. Several fields can share a name, so make sure it's the one your project uses.

genFieldsHowBody2.message: This page only checks the format, not whether the field exists. After downloading, import the file yourself and open the Timeline to check.

genDefaultsIntro.message: Default colors and switches after import. Everyone can adjust them later in the extension panel.

genProgressEnabled.message: Calculate progress from Milestone linked issues

genLinkTypeHelp.message: Separate multiple IDs with commas. Required for progress.

genWeightHelp.message: Not started counts as 0, done as 1, and in progress as 0.5 by default.

genWeekendHelp.message: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday … 6 = Saturday, separated by commas.

genLookupHint.message: Links appear after you enter the site URL and open Jira in a new tab.

genAfterDownload.message: After downloading, import the file yourself and check the Jira Timeline before sharing it with users.

genPrivacyReminder.message: The file contains your company's Jira URL and field details. Don't post it anywhere public.

genErrOneId.message: Enter only one ID per type.

genErrSiteUrl.message: Enter the Jira site URL, for example https://your-site.atlassian.net, with nothing after it.

genErrFileTooLarge.message: The file is too large. Choose a configuration JSON file.

genErrMultipleSites.message: This file contains several sites. Only one site can be edited at a time, so it wasn't loaded.

genErrMultipleScopes.message: This file contains several project configurations. Only one can be edited at a time, so it wasn't loaded.

genErrMultipleIds.message: An issue type in this file has more than one ID. Each type can have only one, so it wasn't loaded.

genErrInvalidJson.message: This file isn't valid JSON. Choose it again.

genErrUnsupportedOption.message: This configuration file has an option that isn't supported, so it wasn't loaded.

genSummaryOk.message: The format is valid. Ready to download.

genSummaryIncomplete.message: Not finished: enter the site URL, issue types, and required field IDs.

genConfirmReplaceForm.message: What you've entered hasn't been downloaded and will be replaced. Load the file anyway?

genDownloaded.message: Downloaded. Import it yourself and open the Timeline to check before sharing it with users.

vDays.message: Holidays and make-up workdays need real YYYY-MM-DD dates, each day at most once (up to 300 holidays and 100 workdays).

vDayName.message: A day name can have at most 50 characters and no < or >.

vPropertyLabel.message: The source label or update time in the project settings is invalid.

sessionPropertyUnavailable.message: The project settings saved in Jira couldn't be read; using the imported file if there is one.

sessionPropertyInvalid.message: The project settings saved in Jira are invalid; ask your Jira admin to save them again. Using the imported file if there is one.

sessionPropertyIgnored.message: The project settings in Jira include options this version doesn't support; they were skipped. Update the extension to use them.

sourceProperty.message: Settings from the Jira project ({by}, updated {date})

sourceFile.message: Settings from the imported configuration file.

calendarWeekendsOnly.message: No holiday list: only weekends are marked.

colorEnabledLabel.message: Use this color (off: keep the Jira color)

genErrDayLines.message: Use one YYYY-MM-DD date per line, optionally followed by a name. Check lines: {lines}.

genHolidaysHelp.message: Days off on normal weekdays, one per line, e.g. "2027-01-01 New Year's Day". Years listed here count as complete; working days are not shown across years without data.

genWorkdaysHelp.message: Weekend days that are working days, one per line. Leave empty if you have none.

optionsSourceProject.message: Jira project settings: saved in the project by your admin. They apply automatically; no need to import a file here.

optionsSourceFile.message: Imported configuration file: the file you import on this page. Used only for projects without Jira project settings.

optionsSourceRule.message: If a project has both, the Jira project settings take priority. “Reset my preferences” returns to the project or file defaults.

popupManagedByProject.message: Your Jira admin manages the basic settings for this project. No need to import a configuration file.

popupFileOverridden.message: The configuration file you imported has no effect on this project: when a project has Jira project settings, those take priority.
